div.head: I Cn 17.3
div.ab: ⁊ gyf hwa oðrum sceole borh oððe bote æt woruldlicum þingum, gelæste hít him georne ǽr oððe æfter.
And gyf hwa oðrum scyle borh oððe bote æt weorldlicum þingum, geleste hit him georne ær oððe æfter.
⁊ gyf hwá oðrum scyle borh oððe bote æt woruldlicum ðingum, gelæste hít him georne ǽr oððe æfter.
Et si quis alteri debitor est de plegiatione uel aliqua contingentium secularium emendatione, reddat ei sedulo prius aut postea.
⁊ gyf hwá oðrum scyle borh oððe bote æt woruldlicum ðingum, gelæste hít him georne ǽr oððe æfter.
And if anyone owes another a debt or compensation in connection with secular matters, he shall render it to him readily either before or after [the festival].
Und wenn einer dem andern Geborgtes oder Bussgeld aus weltlichen Beziehungen schuldet, zahle er es ihm willig vor oder nach [dem Feste],
And if anyone owes another a loan or compensation in secular matters, let him pay it to him willingly before or after [the feast],
div.note: Liebermann compares VI Atr 25.2.; Robertson (p. 139) takes I Cn from B, which begins at ‘mæssedæg’ in 14.2, the earlier clauses being supplied from G
